category_edits.rationale: Halve the configured causal context length, rounding up with a minimum of one, to reduce stale history and recurrent computation. Existing truncation retains recent interactions chronologically, and saved maxlen metadata keeps the generated predictor consistent. Preserve the GRU architecture, loss, optimizer, seeds, routing, and epoch cap.

response.change_summary: Reduce default context from 128 to 64 interactions for training, validation, and metadata-driven prediction across all four category models.
